title: From Text to Voice: A Reproducible and Verifiable Framework for Evaluating Tool Calling LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.15104v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Voice agents increasingly require reliable tool use from speech, whereas prominent tool-calling benchmarks remain text-based. We study whether verified text benchmarks can be converted into controlled audio-based tool calling evaluations without re-annotating the tool schema and gold labels. Our dataset-agnostic framework uses text-to-speech, speaker variation, and environmental noise to create paired text-audio instances while preserving the original dataset annotations. Based on extensive evaluation of 7 omni-modal models on audio-converted versions of Confetti and When2Call, our framework demonstrates that the performance is strongly model- and task-dependent: Gemini-3.1-Flash-Live obtains the highest Confetti score (70.4), whereas GPT-Realtime-1.5 performs best on When2Call (71.9). On Confetti, the text-to-voice gap ranges from 1.8 points for Qwen3-Omni to 4.8 points for GPT-Realtime-1.5. A targeted analysis of failure cases demo

translated_title: 从文本到语音：一个可复现、可验证的工具调用大语言模型智能体评估框架
translated_abstract: 语音智能体日益需要基于语音进行可靠的工具调用，而现有的主流工具调用基准仍然基于文本。我们研究能否在无需重新标注工具模式和标准答案标签的情况下，将经过验证的文本基准转换为可控的基于音频的工具调用评估。我们的框架与数据集无关，通过文本转语音（TTS）、说话人变化和环境噪声来创建成对的文本-音频实例，同时保留原始数据集的标注。基于对7个全模态模型在Confetti和When2Call的音频转换版本上的广泛评估，我们的框架表明性能高度依赖于具体模型和任务：Gemini-3.1-Flash-Live在Confetti上获得最高分（70.4），而GPT-Realtime-1.5在When2Call上表现最佳（71.9）。在Confetti上，文本到语音的性能差距从Qwen3-Omni的1.8分到GPT-Realtime-1.5的4.8分不等。对失败案例的针对性分析显示……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一个无需重新标注、可复现且可验证的框架，利用文本转语音、说话人变化和环境噪声将已有文本工具调用基准转换为可控的音频评估，并揭示全模态模型的工具调用性能高度依赖模型和任务，且从文本到语音存在1.8至4.8分的性能下降。
en_tdlr: A reproducible, verifiable, dataset-agnostic framework that converts verified text tool-calling benchmarks into controlled audio-based evaluations via TTS, speaker variation, and noise—without re-annotation—revealing that omni-modal models' tool-calling performance is strongly model- and task-dependent with a 1.8–4.8 point text-to-voice performance gap.
